numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Nested trust-constr minimization crashes with ValueError: shapes (2,) and (4,) not aligned: 2 (dim 0) != 4 (dim 0) raised from _hessian_update_strategy.py in wMw = Mw.dot(w), because the default BFGS HessianUpdateStrategy object (default argument hess=BFGS()) is shared between constraints and updated by two nested minimizers.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: Nested minimization should complete without a shape-mismatch error; each NonlinearConstraint should get its own new BFGS object rather than a shared default instance.
trigger_conditions: nested optimize.minimize calls using method='trust-constr' with NonlinearConstraint objects using the default hess argument
outer minimize with constraints=NonlinearConstraint(cd_contraint, 0, 0) whose inner objective beta runs a trust-constr minimize with NonlinearConstraint(lsf, 0, 0)
default BFGS hessian update strategy object shared between constraints so two nested minimizers update the same object

input_output_examples.input: abc0 = [4.0, 4.0, 2.0, 3.0] passed to optimize.minimize(beta, abc0, method='trust-constr', constraints=abcd_cons) where beta runs a nested trust-constr minimize with u0=[0.1, 0.1]

oracle_clues: The PR adds a regression test at scipy/optimize/_trustregion_constr/tests/test_nested_minimize.py, which was verified to fail without commit 9b8c707.
Fix changes default hess=BFGS() to hess=None and constructs BFGS() inside __init__ when None.

category_specific_evidence: The bug is a shared mutable default: NonlinearConstraint's default hess=BFGS() was a single object shared across all constraint instances, so two nested minimizers could both update the same HessianUpdateStrategy.
The reproducer in issue#21193 nests scipy.optimize.minimize (trust-constr) inside another minimize call with NonlinearConstraint objects, and prints the result of the outer minimization.
The fix (PR#21203) constructs a new BFGS() per constraint when hess is None, and the test test_gh21193 asserts constraint1.hess is not constraint2.hess.

The issue's reproducer has the constrained nonlinear program with cd_contraint equality 16 - (a^2+b^2)/(c^2+d^2) = 0 and hyp equality constraint 10 + ((u1-a)^2/c^2 - (u2-b)^2/d^2) = 0; no expected numerical value of the objective is stated in the passages.
The test was verified to fail without commit 9b8c707, per the PR discussion.
reproduction_risks: Passages do not state expected or observed numerical values of the objective or solution, so the violated mathematical property cannot be confirmed from them.
The test relies on the default trust-constr HessianUpdateStrategy and a filterwarnings message; behavior may differ across methods.
No dtype, precision, magnitude regime or tolerance is stated in the passages.
